description: This file defines Pydantic data models related to authentication flows for an Atlassian-connected application, including OAuth and API token handling, session information, and response/request schemas.

classes.name: OAuthStartResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the OAuth authorization URL and state parameter

classes.name: OAuthCallbackRequest
classes.description: Request model capturing OAuth callback data including code and state

classes.name: APITokenRequest
classes.description: Request model for API token authentication containing domain, email, and token

classes.name: AuthenticationResponse
classes.description: Response model indicating success or failure of authentication, with optional session and user info

classes.name: SessionInfo
classes.description: Model representing session details, including tokens, timestamps, and provider info

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Model for standard error responses with message and optional error code
